what: uniform weight average of two checkpoints: every tensor of tower.safetensors, scorer.safetensors (main head, layer 32) and aux_scorers.safetensors (exits 12/16/20) is the mean of the two members; nothing is trained
dtypes: mean computed in fp32; tower stored in the first member's tower dtype; heads stored in fp32
asserts: equal readout, layout, option_pool, max_options, arch_extra, residual, logit_cap, head_input_norm, readout_layer; identical tensor names per file
meta: the first member's meta.json plus a soup block (members, weights)
packaging: exit 12 is fitted (4-calibration.json) but dropped at packaging, as for v6.0-VL

selection.rule: pre-registered before any averaged number: the average must beat the better single member on half B of the policy development set at layer 32, then pass every release bar on one evaluation read
selection.dev_B_layer32: +0.0129 over the better member (z 2.08); +0.0184 (z 4.4) with the 969 development case ids found in a member's training data dropped

choice_of_weights: after the fact, not a selection: 0.3 / 0.7 (v6.0-VL / member B) is level with 0.5 / 0.5 within noise, 0.7 / 0.3 is lower by 0.016 (z -3.7). The gain is in the tower: the averaged tower with v6.0-VL's own heads recovers 98% of the averaged model's gain at layer 32; v6.0-VL's tower with averaged heads recovers none.
